Interface WorkspaceManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
WorkspaceManagerImpl
public interface WorkspaceManager
Public API for the Workspace invalid input: '&' Project module.

Transport split (same as task):

  • Reads — REST (GET /workspaces, GET /workspaces/{id}, /members, /milestones, /progress)
  • Writes — WebSocket (WORKSPACE_CREATE implemented; WORKSPACE_UPDATE, WORKSPACE_JOIN, WORKSPACE_LEAVE planned)
Listing/getting workspaces over WebSocket is intentionally not implemented; use REST.
